INDEPENDENT ADVERSARY — area deletion-managed-media, attacked 30a4065036a917514fb4984fde73f87867f38619 (git rev-parse HEAD before branching). Attack branch devin/pp/adv/deletion-managed-media-30a40650 @ a659aa827376627225a22ca47fbbdeddeaab7c99 adds ONLY new test files (git status showed no production or existing-test changes; commit touches 6 new files). Baseline at HEAD (VERIFIED): `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci --silent __tests__/accountDeletion.test.ts __tests__/deletionOperationIsolation.test.ts __tests__/deletionOperationRecovery.test.ts __tests__/deletionOperationTransport.test.ts __tests__/deletionCapabilityJournal.test.ts` exit 0, 5 suites / 160 passed / 0 failed (mobile-baseline-deletion.log); `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0 after `npm ci` (first tsc run failed only because @sentry/react-native was missing from node_modules — environment, not code); `npx eslint apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/` exit 0; `npx prettier --check apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/ services/media-worker/test/adv/` exit 0; `cd services/media-worker && npm run typecheck` exit 0; `deno fmt --check` + `deno lint` + `deno check` on the new Deno file exit 0.

CONFIRMED BREAKS (7, in `breaks`): M04 lost-response dead end (P1), M05 operationId unbound (P2), M06 'Google Play' copy (P2), M02 no native media purge on local deletion (P1), W02 sweep starvation past LIMIT 50 (P1), W03a referenced original destroyed with active catalog row left dangling (P2), W03b final_hard_delete permanently failed on pro_reference FK (P1, plane caveat). Root observation for M02/M04/M05: at HEAD `ManageAccountScreen.tsx` does not import deletionOperation*, `__tests__/w08ManageAccountDeletion.test.tsx` and `__tests__/w08OwnerCleanup.test.ts` do not exist, and `apps/mobile/src/media` does not exist — W08-01/W08-04 objectives are not integrated into the shipping path yet.

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (VERIFIED, exact commands):
[mobile] `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci --verbose __tests__/adv/` exit 1, 14 total / 10 passed / 4 failed (mobile-adv-verbose.log). Passing: ADV-M01 completeAccountDeletion(A) removes every owner-scoped row and kv of A while owner B, a look-alike UUID owner (…be39) and device-level kv survive; ADV-M03 a real SQLite trigger RAISE(ABORT,'disk I/O error') on DELETE FROM outbox leaves A fully intact (no half purge), reports failed, and a retry completes without touching B; ADV-M07 two taps on 'Permanently delete' send exactly one confirm and one cleanup; ADV-M08 (7 cases) 202 in_progress, deleted:'true', deleted:1, nested deleted, array body, deleted:true on 500, deleted:true on 409 blocked are never reported as completed deletion (fail closed, unknown state surfaced).
[edge] `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --config deno.json adv_deletion_managed_media.test.ts` exit 0, 8 passed / 0 failed (edge-adv.log): ADV-E01 a provider call returning after lease loss cannot proceed into RevenueCat/Auth; ADV-E02 malformed/stale/contradictory/missing completion receipts never become 'completed'; ADV-E03 self-contradictory leases refused before provider/checkpoint calls; ADV-E04 Apple invalid_grant + rejected apple_unrevocable checkpoint stops before RevenueCat/Auth; ADV-E05 Apple invalid_grant completes via apple_unrevocable and reports manual_action_required (never 'revoked'); ADV-E06 transient Apple/RevenueCat/Auth failures release the lease with stage-specific codes and never skip a stage (external_complete only checkpointed when the failing stage is Auth); ADV-E07 repeated confirm + internal resume of completed work return the durable receipt with zero provider/Auth calls, malformed completed status rejected; ADV-E08 wrong Apple encryption key -> permanent invalid_response, wrong-size key -> configuration (not permanent).
[sql] `cd supabase && docker cp tests/adv/account_deletion_adversary.sql adv-pg:/tests/adv/ && docker exec adv-pg psql -U postgres -d pickle_adv -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /tests/adv/account_deletion_adversary.sql` exit 0, 'ADV SQL assertions passed: 35' (sql-adv.log; pickle_adv = disposable postgres:16 with tests/shim_auth.sql + every supabase/migrations/*.sql applied in order): ADV-S01 permanent Apple failure -> manual_action_required receipt; ADV-S02 stale lease rejected, restart after the Apple checkpoint resumes without re-running Apple; ADV-S03 out-of-band Auth deletion blocked without durable intent; ADV-S04 superseded/unknown state never yields a completed receipt.
[media-worker] `cd services/media-worker && DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgres://postgres:pg@localhost:55432/mediaworker_test npx vitest run test/adv/ --reporter=verbose` exit 1, 2 files / 6 tests / 3 passed / 3 failed (media-worker-adv.log). Passing: ADV-W01 media_purge with inventory > DELETION_TASK_WINDOW erases every object + normalized.mp4 + thumb.jpg of the victim and none of a neighbour, including a neighbour key that is a string-prefix look-alike of a victim key; all tasks 'done'. ADV-W04 (objectStorePaginationAdversary.adv.test.ts) S3 derived-artifact listing follows continuation tokens undefined -> tok-1 -> tok-2 across 2005 keys with correct bucket/prefix, and a later-page listing failure rejects instead of returning a partial inventory.

NOTE for the coordinator: the new files are picked up by default `npx jest --silent` (apps/mobile) and `npm test` (services/media-worker) globs, so those suites will be red on the attack branch by design; run_rls_tests.sh does not pick up supabase/tests/adv/. The Edge deletion has no paged storage fan-out (media is on-device; Auth admin delete cascades), so 'pagination past a page cap' was attacked on the media-worker plane only.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (no verdict guessed): (1) native managed-media namespaces/backup-exclusion/inventory and ClipMediaStore behaviour — `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` on the M4 runner (from the coordinator's Mac; `--remote` is forbidden for this role) or `cd native/managed-media && swift test`; (2) locked files / missing filesystem permissions / app relaunch during a native purge — Xcode + iOS Simulator run of the PickleNative XCTests plus a device run of the Release build (`cd apps/mobile/ios && bundle exec pod install && xcodebuild -workspace PickleSensei.xcworkspace -scheme PickleSensei -configuration Release -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' test`); (3) real Sign in with Apple token revocation and real RevenueCat customer deletion — require APPLE_SIGN_IN_* / REVENUECAT_SECRET_API_KEY against a non-production Supabase project (`supabase functions serve api` + `curl -X POST .../v1/me/delete-confirm`), not run; (4) StoreKit sandbox interaction with deletion — device/simulator with a Sandbox Apple Account; (5) behaviour against production Supabase ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib — never touched. Everything above labelled VERIFIED was executed on Linux against the frozen SHA; INFERRED statements are limited to the code-reading notes inside each break's 'observed'.
